description: Hand cases for the chatCefr.* rows (PL.native-chat-cefr-rows, slice 1): what the corpus (../chat-cefr/chat-cefr-corpus.json, transcribed into chat-cefr-corpus.json) leaves open: chatCefr.section on every world and on unreadable sections (each declared member of the section, answered as valid false and why), the [invalid-input] refusal of an unreadable section by every other row, the level names, the line rule constants, chatCefr.normalizeWord, a section's own percentages, level rows and kind table, a lexicon holding a key twice (the first entry answers), chatCefr.shouldShowVocabHint over every level, absent state and mastered words, a homograph with no evidence, seen keys kept and re-sorted, the whole kind row, a section with no message kinds, and the boundary of every argument. Every answer to a readable section was computed by the export's own rule (pipelines c807d4e, pipelines/game-export/chat-cefr.ts); the refusals are this library's boundary.

chatCefr.section: an unreadable section answers valid false and why, never a refusal
